instruction: Remodel a courtyard hostel from the provided IFC. Open C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit and use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png as the visual reference for the starting condition. Remodel the building into a three-storey courtyard hostel and export the final IFC4 model to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. The final IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, three IfcBuildingStorey entities, nineteen IfcSpace objects, twenty-four IfcWall elements, three IfcSlab elements, and one IfcStair. Name the spaces so they include at least eighteen Bedroom spaces and one Lounge space, with one space named exactly Shared Lounge. The final export should not include IfcRoof, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcCurtainWall, IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. The init model is only a starting point and should be substantially replaced by the hostel layout. Other room arrangement details may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
